product.r3_verdict: Disciplined, genuinely quiet WORKING-class page with one strong idea (the diff-rendered symmetry compare), but a P8 candor break (inferred arm means printed bare) plus a contradictory looping live-dot keep it strong-shippable, not elite.
r3_issues: P8 break (caps at 85): `CTRL 0.59 · TREAT 0.66` (line 479) are inferred per-arm reaction means sitting in the BARE provenance bar with n=240 — an inferred-about-people estimate printed bare is a hard fail. Give them ± and a ◇, or move them out of the recorded-facts strip into the stamped figure.

Topbar live dot loops `.breath` forever (lines 75-77, 363) and pairs with a `--signal-dim` active-tab underline — two signal-family carriers in one region, AND a perpetual 'live reading' cue while the hero itself stamps 'NO READING RUNNING'. On a WORKING/idle snapshot page the dot should rest (ink, no breath) unless a run is actually live.

`delta: ±2 copy` (line 422) misuses the `±` spread glyph for a copy-count diff — it reads as an uncertainty stamp on a recorded structural delta, muddying the candor grammar. Use a plain `~2` or `Δ2 copy` so `±` stays reserved for inferred spread.

auth.r3_verdict: Disciplined candor and clean craft on the era's most templated split-screen auth skeleton, undercut by a real P9 break — a live 1,200-agent Canvas field (run twice, desktop + mobile) on a non-showpiece surface the page litigates rather than fixes.
r3_issues: P9 break (caps at 85): auth is not one of the 4 showpiece archetypes, yet it runs a live 1,200-pt Canvas drift field — and a 2nd 420-pt field on mobile. Replace both with a frozen Tier-3 SVG distribution poster (mean line in --signal-dim, arm opacity ≥0.6) or a single isolated-agent motif; a still poster is also more confident than an animated panel.

§5.6/P3 drift fidelity: the .uncal drift and the canvas rAF loop run perpetually with no 20s idle-pause (only hover freezes). Add the mandated PAUSE-after-20s-idle so the drift isn't a second forever-loop competing with the status dot.

Reconceive auth instead of dressing it in the system: the submit button is forced to be the lime signal carrier, but signing in is not a live reading — drop the split-screen-+-animated-panel default and find a layout/idea that stops a top designer, since the candor primitives alone (P7/P8, handled well) don't make a templated skeleton elite.

crawl-setup.r3_verdict: Law-clean, disciplined WORKING config page — the demoted-inflight-button / single-dot signal handoff is genuinely instrument-grade — but it's correct rather than memorable, and its one graphic earns its space the least.
r3_issues: The 128px cohort poster is the weakest element: a generic axis-less bell polyline with decorative .5α arm dots and no mean label — P10 says static posters must be interrogable. Give it a real axis/scale + a labeled mean, or cut it and let the manifest carry the page.

Audit rail reads as four equal-weight bordered slabs; the Manifest (declared the 'primary audit surface') doesn't visually dominate over run-status. Lift the manifest's weight (heavier dt/dd contrast or a quiet ground tint) so the record out-ranks the watch block.

Latent specificity bug: .btn.live.inflight sets color:--text-mut but the later [aria-disabled="true"] rule overrides it to --text-faint, so the 'Crawl in flight' label renders at ~2.9:1. Resolve to --text-mut so the carefully-authored inflight color actually applies.

about.r3_verdict: Exemplary RECORD-class discipline — the candor distinction is genuinely *shown* — but it's a tasteful wireframe of an About page: all hairlines-and-type, one generic signature graphic, zero human warmth, and no stop-scrolling moment.
r3_issues: Give the page ONE crafted visual moment beyond the stock two-bell poster: the distribution SVG is a generic overlap and its CI ribbon (x=130,w=20) sits off-center under the magenta mean at x=140 — redraw it as a real artifact, or add a bespoke diagram/portrait so the bottom 70% isn't undifferentiated ink-on-sheet.

The founders section is name+bio text only ('A. Kohavi', no face/presence) — the best About pages make the team a human beat; this reads as a placeholder, the single biggest gap vs Stripe/Linear tier.

P7 nick: in the Console-well pbar, .uncal applies --spread-dim (#90815F ≈3.4:1 on #0B1220) to the running WORD 'UNCALIBRATED', not just the ◇ glyph — bump the word to --text-mut and reserve spread-dim for the glyph/± per the v2.1 tightening.

simulations-new.r3_verdict: Conceptually rigorous and well-budgeted — the drift-as-draft-state field and paired-arm preview are genuine ideas — but a P7 sub-AA break on provenance words and a too-faint resting showpiece keep it just shy of elite.
r3_issues: P7 BREAK (caps at 85): the .word class renders running provenance words — UNCALIBRATED, DRIFTING, DRAFT, UNCOMMITTED (lines 88/128/146/285) — in --spread-dim (#90815F, ~3.4:1, the spec's own sub-AA value). P7 reserves --spread-dim strictly for the ◇ glyph and the ± value; running words must be --text-mut (#929BAE). Repaint every .word to --text-mut, leave only .glyph in --spread.

Resting showpiece under-delivers: dots sit at 0.32α core (+0.45× glow) graphite dust before any wavefront, so on first paint the field reads as near-empty/low-contrast noise rather than 'a living population.' Lift the resting agent alpha to ~0.5–0.6 (still draft-quiet, P10-legible) so the SHOWPIECE earns its 56vh on entry, not only during the 420ms-delayed sweep.

Borderline candor: persona-share chips (24%/19%/… lines 469–476) and 'renormalize to 100%' are presented bare. If these are cohort population shares they read as inferred shares (P8) and should carry ◇; if they are pack-config composition, label the region so the exemption is unambiguous rather than leaving it to inference.

landing.r3_verdict: High-craft, on-thesis field-as-hero that nails candor scoping and the signal budget — but the signature Population Field loops its full wavefront→settle→dissolve cycle forever (perpetual lime sweep), a clean P3 break that caps it below elite.
r3_issues: P3 HARD BREAK: the #field canvas runs `c=(t+clockOffset)%CYCLE` (CYCLE=8s) with no termination, re-running the lime wavefront crest + re-sort + dissolve indefinitely. P3 explicitly forbids 'perpetual lime wavefront sweeps' and 're-running count-up/re-sort/dissolve loops' — make it ONE-SHOT: play once on entry/seed, then rest to pure ≤2px curl-drift holding the settled poster. The status dot must be the page's only infinite loop.

Two lime elements are live in the first viewport on load — the topbar `.dot.live` breath AND the hero field wavefront crest. Even though §1.9 scopes the nav as a separate region, having both pulse simultaneously on first paint dilutes the 'lime = one live reading here' read; consider holding the nav status dot until the field actually fires, so a single signal owns first paint.

Craft-not-law: the mono-dense `field-readout` (+3.6 ±1.4pp ◇ / day-7 retention · sentiment 0.71) plus the silkscreen provbar risks reading as generic fintech-telemetry pastiche rather than a bespoke instrument. Give the marquee figure more typographic distinction from the provenance chrome (scale/weight/position) so the reading clearly dominates the metadata, per P10's spirit.

agent-transcript.r3_verdict: Disciplined, genuinely quiet transcript with excellent candor-scope and a single-carrier composer — but a P7 break (uncalibrated WORDS in sub-AA --spread-dim) caps it, and first-viewport provenance redundancy keeps it short of elite.
r3_issues: P7 break: the running honesty WORDS are in --spread-dim (#90815F, ~3.4:1, reserved for the ◇ glyph + ± value only). Recolor .uncal ("UNCAL"/"UNCALIBRATED" at lines 91/128) and .foot-note .stamp (the "◇ NO GROUND TRUTH · reading will not lock until graded" sentence, line 374) to --text-mut; keep --spread-dim strictly on the ◇ glyph.

Provenance/identity redundancy in the first viewport: "TREATMENT"/arm identity prints 3× (prov-bar CH2·TREATMENT, arm-chip "Treatment · Avira", title) and n=240 prints 3× (topbar, prov-bar, persona-title persona-n + chip). The prov-bar already carries CH2·TREATMENT·n=240 — drop the persona-n span and fold "Avira" into the prov-bar so the title reads as a name, not a restated receipt.

Copy duplication weakens the hierarchy: verdict-note ("gated on a sticky per-profile dismiss") and syn-line ("gated on a sticky dismiss") restate the same gate. Let the verdict own the gate once and let the synthesis add new information, not echo it.

personas-list.r3_verdict: A disciplined, genuinely-restrained WORKING list that nails candor scope and the static-poster law — but one P7 break (text-faint on the breadcrumb separator) caps it, and an inverted poster hierarchy keeps it just shy of elite.
r3_issues: P7 BREAK (caps at 85): .crumbs .sep uses --text-faint (#646E84, ~2.9:1) for the '/' separator — P7 forbids --text-faint on separators (disabled-only). Change line 59 to --text-mut.

P10 inverted hierarchy on the poster: the exempt raw count '2,500' renders at 30px full ink and visually dominates the actual inferred marquee reading '+0.16 ±0.07 ◇' at only 18px. Promote the inferred mean to the largest figure (or shrink the count) so the reading — not an exempt fact — is the focal point.

P2 signal leak in the logbook: RAMP[5]=#39B894 is literally --signal-dim, so p_06's swatch and its share bar render lime-family as a categorical identity color — signal must mean 'live reading,' not a ramp endpoint. Swap the last ramp stop to a neutral/arm-tinted hue.

personas-new.r3_verdict: Disciplined, system-fluent SHOWPIECE with a genuinely good binned-depth field — but a P7 sub-AA break on the "UNCALIBRATED" running word caps it, and a muddled axis/figure relationship keeps it short of elite.
r3_issues: P7 break: the running word 'UNCALIBRATED' renders in --spread-dim (#90815F, ~3.4:1, sub-AA) in the topbar prov-bar (line 259), field legend (line 288), and tooltip — bump the WORD to --text-mut and keep --spread-dim strictly for the ◇ glyph and the ± value.

Conceptual axis conflict: the field's x-axis is labeled 'distinctiveness' but the hero figure is 'cluster stability' and hover only ever surfaces share% + a canned reaction — wire hover to the actual distinctiveness value (the x the dots are binned on) so the axis stops being semi-decorative.

Reactions are rotated by index (REACTIONS[bi % len]) and mislabel personas ('Compliance-first Buyers' → 'rejects on price'); tie each reaction to its persona's real meaning, and pull the field-reading overlay clear of the leftmost column (x:0.18) so the hero label doesn't collide with the data it describes.

agent-detail.r3_verdict: Disciplined, on-system WORKING page — transcript-as-hero with exemplary candor scope — but quiet to a fault, with a slightly inverted focal hierarchy and two competing perpetual loops that keep it short of elite.
r3_issues: P3 tension: two infinite breathe loops run at once (topbar `.dot.breathe` LIVE 1:1 + `.cdot.breathe` composing). One viewport should pulse once. Freeze the topbar LIVE dot to static (or drop it) while the in-thread composing breath is active so a single status pulse owns the eye.

P10/hierarchy: no inferred figure commands first paint. The brightest object is the numberless lime motif dot (opacity 0.45) while the real readings are 10px `--text-mut` sentiment lines and a collapsed drawer. Promote one marquee reading — e.g. surface the current reaction `+0.71 ±0.14 ◇` as a resting `data-lg` figure beside the motif at ~0.7 ink — so the page has a legible focal reading, not just a decorative dot.

Craft ceiling: the thread is a conventional left-border-agent / filled-PM-bubble chat pattern that reads as a competent supporting surface, not a stop-scroll moment. The 128px motif column is on-spec but inert — either give it a quantified, interrogable mark (this agent's position vs cohort, labeled) or tighten it and reclaim the width for a denser reading header.

simulations-list.r3_verdict: Elite WORKING-class discipline — brutal-quiet logbook, finite drift, clean candor scope, no verdict leak — but uncalibrated PROVENANCE WORDS are painted in sub-AA --spread-dim, the one law-break the honesty surface least forgives (P7 cap).
r3_issues: P7 break (caps at 85): the .uncal class paints running word strings in --spread-dim (#90815F ≈ 3.4:1, below AA) at lines 451 ('UNCALIBRATED'), 485 ('EMPTY (0 GRADED)'), and the topbar/prov-bar 'UNCALIBRATED'. Bump these WORDS to --text-mut (#929BAE, 5.4:1); reserve --spread-dim strictly for the ◇ glyph and the ± value.

Live state is surfaced three ways in one viewport — topbar 'CH1 LIVE' breathing dot, the latest-reading strip, and the table running-chip — which dilutes the 'one live reading' claim the copy makes. Pick the strip as the showpiece and demote the topbar reference to a single quiet ◇ provenance token without the lime word, so the region carriers don't echo.

pending/failed/running rows all reuse the same hollow ◇ glyph, conflating 'no reading yet' with 'uncalibrated in progress'. Give the no-reading states a neutral em-dash-only mark (drop the ◇, which the system attaches to inferred readings) so the glyph stays meaningful.

capability-detail.r3_verdict: All ten mechanical laws pass cleanly — the named R2 failure (mid-scroll inversion + inverted P10 hierarchy) is genuinely fixed: route-locked Sheet, a single Console well as the lone dark/signal region, a legible resting hero, an interrogable poster; disciplined and shippable, but bounded by being a deliberately-still RECORD page that can't earn a stop-scrolling moment.
r3_issues: Candor-scope ambiguity on the noise floor: 0.58 is a model-derived/inferred floor yet prints bare both times (lines 427, 483) while every other inferred figure wears ± + ◇ — either stamp it (0.58 ±0.NN ◇) or visibly reframe it as a recorded threshold so it stops reading as an unstamped estimate.

Hero baseline cluster is slightly busy: the big lime 0.71 plus --spread ±0.05 plus the --spread-dim ◇ glyph (lines 423-425) sit on one baseline at three colors/sizes — tighten the ± and ◇ into a single quieter stamp unit so the marquee figure lands as one object, not three.

Minor polish: 'cr-9247…9c21' mid-truncation in the spine (line 387) reads unrefined for a provenance id, and the poster-head 'no reading running' label (line 433) is redundant with the legend's static cue — drop one.

feature-pack.r3_verdict: Elite restraint and a textbook read of the impact budget on a WORKING list page — but P7 is broken (the "UNCALIBRATED" word and the entire footer honesty clause render in --spread-dim #90815F, ~3.4:1, failing AA), which caps it and ironically wounds the system's own candor virtue.
r3_issues: P7 break (hard AA fail): move the running words to --text-mut. .prov-bar .unc UNCALIBRATED (#90815F ~3.4:1) and the whole footer clause '◇ UNCALIBRATED — coverage readings are uncertain by design' (.foot .gly) must be --text-mut; keep --spread-dim ONLY on the ◇ glyph and the ±0.04 value.

Tighten the table's signal discipline (P2 borderline): the coverage cell repeats a --signal-dim ◆ graded glyph across many rows, reading as a second quiet carrier competing with the hero's one bright --signal. Demote ◆/◇ toward ink/--text-mut so the 0.84 is unambiguously the page's sole signal.

Kill redundant taxonomy for real breathing room: each row carries a .domain-chip ('Playback') that merely restates the group heading it already sits under ('Playback & Listening'). Drop the per-row domain chip under grouped view to sharpen the row and cut visual noise.

app-shell.r3_verdict: Law-clean and genuinely disciplined — the epistemology is encoded in pixels (gated verdicts, scoped candor, frozen-poster reclass) — but the deliberately-quiet hero scatter is competent-not-breathtaking and the 52px topbar is an unresolved cluster of similar-weight mono fragments, keeping it just shy of elite.
r3_issues: Hero poster reads as a generic data-viz scatter: 0.7α dots under `lighter` compositing plus grain+vignette muddy the silhouette and bury the --signal-dim mean line and --spread CI ribbon. Make the distribution legibly read as a distribution — cleaner bin envelope, lift the mean/CI contrast above the overlays, drop the additive blending so dots don't smear into noise.

Resolve the topbar: wordmark + route-desig + 4 crumb-tabs + run-ref pill + 2 icon-btns all crammed into 52px at similar mono/sans weights makes it the least-resolved region. Give the run-ref chip clearer separation (or move provenance off the chrome), and let the active tab carry more weight than the org designator.

Below-the-fold reads as one flat gray register (eyebrow, page-sub, section meta, table headers all ~--text-mut). Brutal-quiet still needs one or two crisp focal beats — tighten the visual hierarchy between section title, meta, and body so 'quiet' doesn't become 'monotone'.
app-shell.codex_note: codex 73: rebuild around the working object — one prioritized bet ledger + one live-reading state, zero valence color, drop the decorative poster hero unless it directly improves triage; reads like a dark Linear-ish admin surface with nicer type. Ensure NO lime on any verdict (incl. the graded Ship row).

simulation-results.r3_verdict: A genuine measurement instrument — the live agent field earns its showpiece and every color/candor law holds; held back from elite by triplicated provenance strips and an overcrowded verdict band.
r3_issues: Provenance silkscreen is triplicated: the full 'n=384 · seed 0x4f17 · groq/llama-3.3-70b · 2026-W25 · ◇ UNCALIBRATED' strip repeats in the topbar (471-478), the field legend (490-497), and the glass chan-legend (567-574) within two viewports — violates §7.3's one-bar-per-region budget. Keep ONE full bar (topbar), demote the field legend and glass legend to a compact 'CH1 · ◇' reference.

The field-verdict bottom band is overcrowded: the 86px figure + verdict tag compete with a right-side .field-readout (508-513) that stacks three lines of 11px mono (REJECTS/ADOPTS axis, 71/18/11 split, CTRL●192 TREAT●192 · hover a dot). It reads as telemetry clutter over the vignette. Cut it to one line (the adopt/neutral/reject split) and let the masthead figure own the band.

Cohort-register settle deltas print bare ('+0.71 / +0.40', 727+) carrying candor only via one ◇ on the column header. These are inferred per-agent sentiment means — P8's example wants the delta itself stamped. Either add ±NN to at least the column-summary deltas or make the inferred-◇ scope unmistakable, since raw counts in the same table are correctly bare.
simulation-results.codex_note: codex 86: cut repeated provenance/candor scaffolding ~35%; let the Field + one ruthless decision narrative dominate; stop over-explaining honesty so the showpiece keeps authority.

persona-detail.r3_verdict: A disciplined RECORD page that cleanly passes all ten laws and fixes the exact P8 mislabel R2 flagged — brutally quiet, serif-led, candor scoped both ways; held just below elite by an under-annotated lone poster, sub-10px mono labels, and a faintly pitchy masthead voice.
r3_issues: The one frozen poster is shape-only and fails P10's 'interrogable' bar: the dashed mean tick has no numeric label, there is no x-axis annotation (reaction axis: rejects→adopts) and no value scale — add a labeled mean and an axis caption so the figure can be read, not just glanced at.

Functional labels drop below the legibility floor: poster-cap/poster-foot at 9px and spine-k at 9.5px mono uppercase clear AA contrast but read cramped — lift functional labels to 10.5–11px to match Linear/Stripe-tier label sizing.

Masthead voice drifts from §7.4's 'lab-notebook, archival' register toward pitch ('in six minds', 'run a change past before you ship it', em-dash lede italic) — flatten to a plain record sentence so the Sheet reads as a document, not marketing.
persona-detail.codex_note: codex 88 (nearest to elite): make the first persona record feel like a TRUE PRINTED ARTIFACT not a styled data card — stronger editorial hierarchy, FEWER repeated diamond/pm micro-stamps, add one more memorable comparative figure/table only Sidira would have.
